claim: The native tactic-route learner no longer selects from the fixed 136-entry categorical action grid. At every retained state it deterministically generates a bounded ephemeral catalog of parameterized tactic-family instances, ranks exact descriptors under one stable family schema, and executes the selected instances through the existing typed tactic runtime.

implementation.instance_identity: family slug plus a content digest of the exact typed executor description
implementation.operational_serialization: existing binary tactic decision journal, content-addressed checkpoint store, input tape, and native episode shards; JSON is used only for this readable report

scope: This proves state-conditioned generation and native execution of previously unlisted parameter instances. The terminal observation is integration evidence only, not a sub-125 route claim. Bounded multi-family composition, outcome-conditioned proposal adaptation, held-out-goal validation, and exact tape retention for every rejected proposal remain unfinished.
